# TemporalPrecisionParallelism

**Domain**: iNEST
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted
**Last updated**: 2026-08-04

## Definition
A training method that parallelizes the temporal dimension of spiking neural networks by processing multiple time steps concurrently while maintaining precise spike timing. Enables faster training of temporally precise SNNs, which is critical for real-time neuromorphic applications in iNEST where timing accuracy is paramount.
